file_collections.name: features
file_collections.description: Audio-derived features for each recording. Dense features are distributed as Apache Parquet files, each element carrying participant_id, session_id, task_name, n_frames and the feature tensor; per-recording scalar features and audio quality metrics are distributed as tab-delimited files. Every data file is accompanied by a JSON data dictionary sharing its file stem and describing the feature and the processing used to prepare it.

resources.name: torchaudio_spectrogram.parquet
resources.description: Spectrograms of dimension 201 by T generated with a 25 ms window size, 10 ms hop length and a 400-point FFT; 29,278 records.

resources.name: torchaudio_mel_spectrogram.parquet
resources.description: Mel spectrograms of dimension 60 by T generated with a 25 ms window size, 10 ms hop length, a 400-point FFT and 60 Mel bins; 29,278 records.

resources.name: torchaudio_mfcc.parquet
resources.description: Mel-frequency cepstrum coefficients of dimension 60 by T using the same parameters as the Mel spectrograms; 29,278 records.

resources.name: torchaudio_pitch.parquet
resources.description: Detected pitch (fundamental frequency) over time, dimension T, with minimum and maximum pitch of 80 and 500; 32,522 records.

resources.name: sparc_ema.parquet
resources.description: Estimated electromagnetic articulography from a deep learning model, dimension T by 12, the twelve values being X and Y positions of tongue dorsum, tongue body, tongue tip, lower incisor, upper lip and lower lip; 28,640 records.

resources.name: sparc_loudness.parquet
resources.description: Estimated loudness based on the average absolute amplitude of the waveform, dimension T, using 20 ms windows; 31,855 records.

resources.name: sparc_periodicity.parquet
resources.description: Estimated periodicity, the confidence of pitch presence, derived using 20 ms windows, dimension T; 31,872 records.

resources.name: sparc_pitch.parquet
resources.description: Estimated fundamental frequency of the audio signal over a range of 50 to 550 Hz, dimension T, computed with a different algorithm from the torchaudio pitch; 31,872 records.

resources.name: ppgs.parquet
resources.description: Phonetic posteriorgram probabilities across 40 phoneme categories, dimension 40 by T, at a frame rate of 100 Hz; 29,289 records.

resources.name: static_features.tsv
resources.description: Features derived from the raw audio with one feature per audio recording, drawn from openSMILE, Praat, parselmouth and torchaudio; one row per unique recording.

resources.name: audio_quality_metrics.tsv
resources.description: One feature per audio recording derived from the raw audio, relating to quality control metrics.

file_collections.name: phenotype
file_collections.description: Organized information collected from the participant or another individual during their encounter, as tab-delimited files each paired with a JSON data dictionary, grouped into confounders, demographics, diagnosis (per-condition files covering airway stenosis, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, anxiety, benign lesions, bipolar disorder, cognitive impairment, control, COPD and asthma, depression, glottic insufficiency, laryngeal cancer, laryngeal dystonia, laryngitis, muscle tension dysphonia, Parkinson's disease, precancerous lesions, unexplained chronic cough and unilateral vocal fold paralysis), enrollment (eligibility, enrollment form, participant), questionnaire (ADHD adult, custom affect scale, DSM-5 adult, dyspnea index, GAD-7, Leicester cough questionnaire, PANAS, PHQ-9, productive vocabulary, psychiatric history, PTSD adult, VHI-10, voice perception) and task (acoustic task, harvard sentences, random item generation, recording, session, stroop, winograd).

file_collections.name: metadata
file_collections.description: A binary Parquet file and its data dictionary holding per-recording metadata, including task instructions and prompts and information about the microphone used and its gain.
